# Experiment 2 — result tables (auto-generated by exp2/analysis.py)

Scores: exact-match accuracy on held-out problems (arith/symbol/pattern) or fraction of sampled sentences grammatical in the model's own word order (grammar). `retention` = mean C own-score / mean A own-score. `cross` = best score on any *other* (task, variant). Fingerprints compare C_i with its own source A_i vs. same-variant siblings (other independently trained models of the same task variant): `ident` = fraction of C_i whose nearest model (KL on own-variant text) is A_i; `KL self/sib` = KL(A_i‖C_i) / mean KL(A_j‖C_i); `agree` = identical answers on held-out problems; `errcopy` = among problems the reference gets wrong, fraction where C gives the same wrong answer. Weight-space: `w-ident` = C_i's weights are nearest to A_i's among all probe inputs; `spread` = mean pairwise distance of outputs / of inputs (1 = as diverse as inputs, 0 = constant output).
